info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Resolution API
info.description: The Fraud Resolution API facilitates the identification and management of potential fraud cases within banking transactions. It enables compliance teams to access comprehensive reports and insights regarding flagged transactions, aiding in the efficient resolution of suspicious activities. This API is essential for financial institutions aiming to mitigate risks and enhance compliance with regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include compliance officers, risk management teams, and fraud analysts who utilize this API for proactive fraud detection and investigation.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about fraud resolution processes within compliance. It supports querying specific aspects related to fraud management and resolution strategies.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving fraud resolution compliance information. This request allows the client to specify parameters to filter the results, ensuring efficient and targeted responses.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the expected data.

GetFraudResolutionComplianceRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the Fraud Resolution operation in compliance operations. This string should contain the necessary details for the operation.
